proposal_metadata.title: Supervisor-worker live steering and procedure distillation
proposal_metadata.author: claude_cowork_opus5
proposal_metadata.rationale: The canonical loop models runs as atomic. Adds separate nodes for mid-run bounded steering and post-verification procedure distillation so experimental results can be attributed to one mechanism rather than both.
proposal_metadata.verification_plan: Static-handoff baseline vs bounded-steering supervisor at equal total token budget; measure attempts-to-green, cost per green unit, and supervisor-attributable regressions. See companion markdown proposal.

add_nodes.label: Supervisor live steering with bounded intervention budget
add_nodes.description: A supervisor observes worker progress mid-run and may issue a bounded number of scoped corrections before the unit completes. The intervention budget is definitional: an unbounded supervisor is a second executor sharing the worker's scope, not a steering mechanism.

add_nodes.label: Post-verification procedure distillation
add_nodes.description: After a run whose verification passed, extract a reusable procedure and make it available to later runs. Admissible only from runs carrying an executable check; the distilled procedure retains the identity of the check that authorised it, so weak checks cannot launder a trajectory into policy.

add_nodes.label: Test: bounded steering vs static handoff at equal budget
add_nodes.description: Controlled comparison on one bounded task family: static handoff baseline vs supervisor with <=3 interventions per unit, total token budget held equal so gains cannot be attributed to extra spend. Primary metric is attempts-to-green; guard metric is supervisor-attributable regression rate.

add_edges.description: Adds a mid-run intervention arrangement to the existing sequential/concurrent/handoff/manager-worker-reviewer set.
Inserts an intervention point between execute and verify, where the loop currently assumes an atomic unit.
Gives the memory/learning concept a concrete mechanism for what is retained across runs.
